title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: history and rollback doors refuse a bare two-holder name and address one holder by ?package=
body:
epic:#31527#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibvyhxPWfA8DsbmVYJ5
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoMEcsa8u1Ymjwvb5h8WsfW2)_

Fixes #32905

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — no skill under `skills/` names the history or rollback door, and the docs that do (`content/docs/api/metadata-api.mdx`, `content/docs/kernel/contracts/metadata-service.mdx`, `content/docs/plugins/adding-a-metadata-type.mdx`, `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`) list the routes without teaching how a name two packages hold is addressed, so no sentence there turns false; the generated API reference (`content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx`) carries the new `packageId` field.

Levels follow the metadata protocol alone (maintainer ruling A, 2026-10-21): `minor` for `@objectstack/spec`, the one package that carries the added protocol surface (`HistoryMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId`, the authorable-surface entry `api/HistoryMetaItemRequest:packageId`, and the new `RollbackMetaItemRequestSchema` that declares the rollback door's request with its `packageId` and a `toVersion` of at least 1), and the level `Check Changeset` demands for `Metadata-protocol: added`. Every other package is `patch` under the BREAKING banner above: `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (`historyMetaItem` and `RollbackMetaItemRequest` take `packageId`), `@objectstack/rest` (both doors accept `?package=`; the rollback door reads `toVersion` through its declaration), `@objectstack/metadata` (new exports `historyRowAttribution`, `ENVIRONMENT_HISTORY_MARK`), `@object-ui/data-objectstack` (`history()` / `rollback()` take `packageId`), `@objectstack/metadata-core` (a field description only) and `@object-ui/app-shell` (no exported signature changes: `HistoryPanel` and `StudioItemTools` are not exported, and `MetadataResourceHistoryPage` keeps its props).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：同名对象由两个包各持一份时（flow、webhook 等按包存储的类型），History 和回滚不再把两家的版本混在一起；不带包的请求在普通读取会拒绝的地方一律返回 409 并列出各家（包括只在代码里提供该名字的包），带 `?package=` 只读、只回滚那一家的版本。非按包存储的类型带 `?package=` 返回 400。控制台的 History 工具会带上条目页的包。
- 为什么改：实测发现，不带包的回滚会把 beta 的版本写进 alpha 的行（静默选中一家），历史列表把两家的版本当成同一条记录。
- 风险与回滚：只有“两家同时持有同名”时行为才变（原来 200，现在 409）；只有一家持有时不带包的历史和回滚与 main 完全一致（包括包接管了环境行之后回滚到环境版本）。回滚方式是直接 revert 这个 PR，不涉及数据迁移。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-history-slots.ts`（判定规则）和 dogfood 测试 `history-rollback-two-holders.dogfood.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 test/history-rollback-two-holders.dogfood.test.ts`，11 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，座位按常规流程审核合入。

## What changed

**The rule** (`historySlotOf`, new `protocol-history-slots.ts`), for a type stored per `(package, name)` (`PACKAGE_SLOTTED_STORE_TYPES`), is the one `DatabaseLoader` already keeps for `MetadataManager.getHistory` / `rollback`:

- **Bare** (no `?package=`): refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` wherever the bare plain read refuses the name, before any row is read or written: a name whose active rows are held by two or more row slots (two packages', or a package's beside the package-less row; `ambiguous-in-environment`, `details.candidates` naming every holder), a name one row holds while a second package ships it in code, and a name two packages ship with no stored row (the registry's `resolveItem`, the resolver the plain read asks, throws the read's own refusal, ADR-0150 D5). One slot or none: answers exactly as on `main`, its whole log, and a bare rollback restores any of its versions with no ownership check (so a name saved package-less and later taken over by a package still rolls back to its environment versions, the M1 case).
- **`?package=P`** (the `/layers?package=` spelling): the slot of the row a read naming `P` serves (`findServedOverlayRow` with `servedOverride`: P's own row, its `.custom` pair's declared override of P, or the package-less row that read falls back to), else P's own slot when P ships the name. A package that neither holds nor ships the name is refused `409` `not-held-by-qualifier` while another slot holds it; with no row stored, a rollback naming a package that is not installed is refused `422 WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED` (the `uninstalledNamedBaseRefusal` a save gets) instead of minting a slot.
- History lists that slot's versions only. An addressed rollback restores into that slot's row, and a version of another slot is refused `404 VERSION_NOT_FOUND` saying whose it is ("Nothing was restored.").
- A version with no attribution (recorded before this release), or attributed to the environment, belongs to a slot only while the name has no other slot: never guessed with two holders.
- **Every other type**: `?package=` stays refused `400` as on `main`, now `VALIDATION_ERROR` (`param: package`) saying why, on both doors before either door's early answers; never accepted and dropped.

**Attribution.** `SysMetadataRepository` (the `/meta` doors' store) now writes `sys_metadata_history.package_id` for by-package types, as `DatabaseLoader` does (`sys_metadata` = the package-less row). `@objectstack/metadata` exports that rule as `historyRowAttribution` / `ENVIRONMENT_HISTORY_MARK` so both writers read one rule.

**Doors.** `GET /meta/:type/:name/history` and `POST /meta/:type/:name/rollback` declare `package` in their closed query sets (`META_ITEM_HISTORY_PARAMS`, `META_ITEM_ROLLBACK_PARAMS`), refuse it repeated, fold `all`/empty to no package (`metaItemPackageBinding`), and render the refusal with `details.candidates` (`packageScopedCandidates`, as the plain read does). The rollback door's request is now declared in spec (`RollbackMetaItemRequestSchema`, `toVersion` a whole number of at least 1), beside `HistoryMetaItemRequestSchema.packageId`, and the door reads `toVersion` (body, `version` alias and query) through that declaration in place of the undeclared whole-number parse, so the published contract and the door spell a version one way.

**Console.** `MetadataClient.history()` / `rollback()` take `packageId` (sent as `?package=`); the History tool sends its item page's `?package=` (routed page), the edit page's history sheet sends `ownerPackageId` (the package its layered read uses), and Studio's item tools send the `packageId` its Layers read already uses.

## Measurement (before the fix)

Posted on the card: 6867256997. On a booted showcase with two `AppPlugin` packages each holding flow `qa_hist_shared`: bare history 200 interleaving both holders' versions; `?package=` 400 (not supported); bare rollback `{toVersion: 2}` (beta's) **200 and wrote beta's body into alpha's row** — a silent pick. Seat regrade: stays p2 (triage 6867291698).

## After the fix (same boot, `history-rollback-two-holders.dogfood.test.ts`)

| Request | Before | After |
|:---|:---|:---|
| bare `GET …/history`, two holders | 200, both holders' versions | **409**, candidates both pairs |
| bare `POST …/rollback`, two holders | 200, writes into one holder | **409**, candidates both, neither row changes |
| `GET …/history?package=alpha.custom` | 400 | 200, alpha's versions only (legacy unattributed excluded) |
| `POST …/rollback?package=alpha.custom` to beta's version | 400 | **404**, "belongs to package 'beta.custom'", nothing restored |
| `POST …/rollback?package=alpha.custom` to an unattributed version | 400 | **404**, "attributed to no package … more than one holds the name" |
| `POST …/rollback?package=alpha.custom` to its own version | 400 | 200, only alpha's row changes |
| `?package=com.qa.hist32905.alpha` (the base) | 400 | addresses its pair's declared override, both doors |
| `?package=` a stranger package | 400 | 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` |
| one row held, a second package ships the name, bare history / rollback | 200 | **409**, the bare plain read's own refusal and candidates; the row is unchanged |
| two packages ship the name, no row stored, bare history / rollback | 200 (empty log) / 404 | **409**, the bare plain read's candidates |
| `?package=` on `view` (not stored per package), both doors | 400 (unknown parameter) | 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`, saying the type is not stored per package (r1 of this PR had accepted and dropped it) |
| no row stored, `rollback?package=` an uninstalled package | 200 | **422** `WRITABLE_PACKAGE_REQUIRED`; `?package=` the installed pair restores (200) |
| one-holder name, bare (CONTROL) | 200 | 200, whole log, bare rollback works |
| name saved package-less, taken over by a package (CONTROL, M1) | 200 | 200: bare rollback to the environment v1, and `?package=` history lists and restores the environment v2 |

## Red lines

1. **Resolution is never loosened.** Nothing that refused before serves now: the bare plain read, `/layers` and every other door are untouched; the new refusals only narrow. `CONTROL: a name one package holds keeps its whole log and its bare rollback, as before` (dogfood), CONTROL — no package, 'all' and the empty string send no 'packageId' (REST), CONTROL: no 'packageId' sends no 'package' key on either door (client) and CONTROL: no '?package=' sends no 'packageId' on either door (console) hold the one-holder and bare spellings unchanged; `rest-server-meta-member-selector.test.ts` stays green with only its measured-set pin taking `package`.
2. **Ambiguity is reported, never guessed.** `the bare history of the two-holder name is refused 409 naming both holders`, `the bare rollback of the two-holder name is refused 409 naming both, and neither holder's row changes`, `?package= restores only that holder's row; the other holder's version and an unattributed one are refused, writing nothing`, `a package that holds nothing of the name is refused naming the holders` (dogfood); the protocol's two-holder refusal is a 409 naming every holder in 'details.candidates' (REST). An unattributed legacy version is never assigned to a holder while two hold the name. Round 2 adds, at the dogfood boot, `a name two packages ship, only one customized, is refused bare at both doors, as the bare plain read refuses it`, `?package= on a type not stored per package is refused 400 at both doors, never accepted and dropped`, `a rollback naming no installed package, of a name no row holds, is refused and stores nothing; an installed holder restores` and `CONTROL (M1): a name the environment saved and a package took over restores the environment's versions, bare and addressed, as before`; in `protocol-history-slots.test.ts` (13 cases) each arm of `historySlotOf` alone, both F5 arms (P ships the name / does not, the read falls back to the package-less row: the environment's slot); and in the REST file, through the real protocol, the `400` on a `view` at both doors. Round 3 adds `a name two packages ship and neither customized, no row stored, is refused bare at both doors…` (dogfood) and `RollbackMetaItemRequestSchema declares what the rollback door enforces` (spec: `0`, `-1`, `1.5`, `'2'`, `true` refused; `1` with every optional member preserved).
3. **Every child is independently releasable.** One PR, no migration (no stored shape changes; `package_id` already existed), no dependency on another child's branch; the bare one-holder behaviour is unchanged so it ships alone.

## Ablations

Each leg mutated one source line with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit once; blob change proved; restore to HEAD proved), rebuilt `@objectstack/metadata-protocol`, proved the mutation live in `dist/` with `scripts/ablation-dist-preflight.mjs` (exit 0, tree clean), and ran `history-rollback-two-holders.dogfood.test.ts`. L1, L2 and L5 ran on r1 and their anchors are unchanged; L3 and L4 were re-anchored onto the rewritten `isVersionOf` (L3b, L4b) and re-run on this head with L6–L10. After the last leg the rebuild was proved clean: `ablation-dist-preflight … __ablate32905 --absent` exit 0 (22 built files), tree clean, and the file is 11/11 green.

| Leg | Mutation (forbidden behaviour put back) | Red (first failure) |
|:---|:---|:---|
| L1 | history skips `historySlotOf` when no package is named | `the bare history of the two-holder name is refused 409 naming both holders`: `expected 200 to be 409` (also the base-package case's bare-409 line) |
| L2 | rollback skips `historySlotOf` when no package is named | `the bare rollback … neither holder's row changes`: `{"success":true,…"restoredFromVersion":1} expected 200 to be 409`; the cascade reddens the two `?package=` cases (the bare write grew alpha's log: `expected [ 1, 3, 6 ] to have a length of 2`) |
| L3b | `isVersionOf` accepts another holder's attributed version | `?package= reads that holder's versions alone…`: `expected [ 1, 2, 3, 4 ] to have a length of 2 but got 4`; `?package= restores only that holder's row…`: `expected 200 to be 404`; also the base-package case |
| L4b | `isVersionOf` accepts an unattributed version under two holders | `?package= reads…`: `expected [ 1, 3, 5 ] to have a length of 2 but got 3`; `?package= restores…`: `expected 200 to be 404`; also the stranger-package case |
| L5 | the `not-held-by-qualifier` refusal disabled | `a package that holds nothing of the name is refused naming the holders`: `{"events":[]} expected 200 to be 409` |
| L6 | bare doors skip the bare plain read's judgement (F3) | `a name two packages ship, only one customized, is refused bare at both doors…`: bare history `expected 200 to be 409` |
| L7 | `?package=` on a type not stored per package let through (F4) | `?package= on a type not stored per package is refused 400 at both doors…`: `{"events":[]} expected 200 to be 400` |
| L8 | the uninstalled-package refusal skipped for an unheld slot (F6) | `a rollback naming no installed package, of a name no row holds, is refused…`: `expected 404 to be 422` |
| L9 | an environment-attributed version no longer belongs to a sole slot (F2, M1) | `CONTROL (M1) … restores the environment's versions, bare and addressed`: `expected [ 4, 5 ] to include 2` |
| L10 | the bare rollback checks ownership as if the slot were shared (F2) | `CONTROL (M1) …`: bare rollback to the environment v1 `expected 404 to be 200` |
| N1 | `RollbackMetaItemRequestSchema.toVersion` loosened back to `z.number()` (spec rebuilt, marker proved in `packages/spec/dist`) | `rest-server-query-number-census.test.ts`, 8 of 35 red: `body { toVersion: 1.5 }`, `0`, `-1`, the `version` alias `1.5` / `0`, and `?toVersion="1.5"` / `"0"` / `"-1"` now reach the protocol instead of answering `400` — the door reads the declaration |

## Acceptance notes

- **Side finding, carried by #32607 (epic:#31527#2), not fixed here.** Reproduction: two writable pairs `com.qa.hist.{alpha,beta}.custom` each `PUT /meta/flow/qa_hist_runtime?package=<pair>` (no `overrides`); bare `GET /meta/flow/qa_hist_runtime` answers **200 with alpha.custom's flow**, while the shipped two-holder name answers 409. This PR's history and rollback doors refuse that name bare (they judge the row slots, not the plain read).
- **Out of scope, with the seat:** `GET /meta/:type/:name/diff?from=&to=` still reads the name's versions across holders (measured: diffs alpha's v1 against beta's v2; it writes nothing), and `@objectstack/client`'s `getHistory` (the SDK) sends no package; the console uses `data-objectstack`'s client. The seat keeps both items. Other package-scoped types not stored per `(package, name)` (page, dashboard, …) are not addressed by ADR-0150 D3 here and their history door answers as before.
- **Gap reported, not fixed here (`action`):** the bare doors judge an action name by its row slots and the registry's `resolveItem` only, not by the bare read's own action judges (`refuseAmbiguousObjectLessAction`, `judgeBareActionRead`). Measured on the #31697 artifact boot (two packages shipping `qa_shared_digest` object-less and `qa_shared_bound` each on its own object, no stored row): bare read `409`, bare history `200 {"events":[]}`, bare rollback `404 VERSION_NOT_FOUND` (nothing restored). The changeset says so.
- **Bundle member:** `HistoryPanel` threads no `member` today (pre-existing); unchanged.
- **Surface beyond the order's list, and why:** `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (the two closed query sets live there, route rule 5); `packages/spec/src/api/protocol.zod.ts` plus its generated `authorable-surface/api.json` and `content/docs/references/api/protocol.mdx` (`HistoryMetaItemRequest` is the protocol's request type); `packages/metadata-core/src/objects/sys-metadata-history.object.ts` (doc of `package_id` only); `ui/…/StudioItemTools.tsx` and `ResourceEditPage.tsx` (one prop each: the History tool's other two mounts), and `StudioDesignSurface.itemTools-28239.test.tsx` (its history/rollback call pins now carry the `packageId` its Layers pin already did).
- **Rulings on the surface, kept:** `meta-item-history-routes.ts` — 5865708652 (letter B, three sites), 5856774816 (three sites), ruling record 6787890900 (two sites), maintainer ruling 2026-08-22 option B; `rest-server-meta-member-selector.test.ts` — 6116165299 (Q2 i, closed sets). No ruling line is edited or removed by this diff (`git diff` of `ruling|maintainer|⛔` lines: two added `⛔` comments, none removed).
